title: Redundant network service path
goal: Show two complete WAN paths behind shared network single points of failure.

rubric.must: Core switch and perimeter firewall are visibly in series ahead of the redundant WAN paths and marked as single points of failure.
Two parallel, complete paths are visible, each containing a router and carrier circuit.
A network service endpoint visibly follows the rejoined WAN paths.
Every network block visibly shows its reliability.
The diagram visibly has input and output terminals around the service path.
The two WAN alternatives are visually separated on parallel rails and rejoin cleanly.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/rbd/ideal.svg (sha256 1f4f1225b103), source sha256 05e0848bacd6. Independent recursive series/parallel drawing with all source blocks, separate complete redundant paths, reliability totals and Birnbaum importance computed from the success expression. Red borders mark actual single points of failure; highest importance uses green (inner border when both roles apply). All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
